claim_boundary: External non-clinical transport evidence on SICAPv2 only. Success can support a bounded claim that frozen PANDA-trained repaired TransnnMIL transports better than frozen PANDA-trained TransMIL under this prespecified external protocol; it cannot establish universal architectural superiority or clinical validity.

antecedent_panda_campaign.checkpoint_selection: PANDA selection partition only; checkpoints already frozen before this external campaign
antecedent_panda_campaign.confirmation_note: No SICAPv2 information may be used to retrain, recalibrate, threshold-tune, seed-select, or checkpoint-select any model.

feature_transport.snapshot_requirement: A local immutable Hugging Face snapshot must be identified and replay-validated against existing PANDA HDF5 rows before any SICAPv2 feature is extracted.

bagging.group_key: image_id / WSI prefix before first underscore
bagging.over_cap_rule: deterministic uniform sample without replacement using seed 20260925; sort selected indices before extraction
bagging.duplicate_region_policy: exclude only the ten frozen duplicate regions listed in external_dataset.duplicate_regions_excluded

inference.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap: resample the five frozen seeds, then resample 95 SICAPv2 patients with replacement and include all WSIs belonging to each sampled patient

interpretation_rules: No SICAPv2 outcome may alter architecture, hyperparameters, preprocessing, checkpoint selection, label mapping, seed set, or success thresholds.
Do not select or report only favorable seeds.
If the primary success rule fails, retain the failure and do not reuse SICAPv2 as a development set.
Descriptive context models do not redefine the primary candidate or comparator.
A passing result supports only external transport superiority over TransMIL under this exact protocol.
